_readme: Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong) titles and meta descriptions for public catalog pages. scripts/apply-zh-seo.py writes these into /zh/ <title>, meta description, Open Graph and Twitter tags, and the matching ItemPage / CollectionPage / WebPage schema. English pages are left alone. New products: set zhType on the product (a Traditional Chinese product noun such as 吊燈 or 雙面鐘). If this file has no entry for the slug, the script builds a title from the brand or designer, model, zhType, colour and condition, then a plain shop description. Do not put prices in titles. Do not use Simplified characters.
